definitions.gloss: oblong; landscape-oriented; horizontally long; wider than tall
definitions.explanation: Describes a shape or object that is wider than it is tall — the horizontal dimension is longer than the vertical. Used for objects, screens, paper orientation, and architectural features.

examples.japanese: {横長|よこなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{横長|よこなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To watch videos on a wide screen.

examples.japanese: ⟦リビング→リビング：11198_ribingu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{横長|よこなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いたら→置く：01092_oku⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ずいぶん⟦{狭|せま}く→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I put a long, wide sofa in the living room, the room became quite cramped.

notes:
Describes something wider than it is tall. Composed of ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (horizontal/side) + {長|なが} (long). Can be used as a noun or as a no-adjective modifier ({横長|よこなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横長|よこなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧: landscape envelope
- {横長|よこなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: widescreen
- {横長|よこなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: horizontally elongated building
- {横長|よこなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧: oblong table

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{縦長|たてなが}→縦長：18226_tatenaga⟧: portrait-oriented; taller than wide — the opposite of {横長|よこなが}
- ⟦{細長|ほそなが}い→細長い：06670_hosonagai⟧: long and thin — emphasizes thinness rather than horizontal orientation

USAGE:
In digital contexts, {横長|よこなが} corresponds to "landscape orientation" (as opposed to ⟦{縦長|たてなが}→縦長：18226_tatenaga⟧ for "portrait orientation"). In everyday use, it describes any object, shape, or space that extends more horizontally than vertically.
